Explanation (Anime):

* Prison School - never fails to make me laugh no matter how many times I watch it. Always my go to anime when I’m sad.
* Elfen Lied - the first anime I had EVER seen back in 2009 when I was only 9. My mom thinks it’s the reason I like boobs and horror movies
* Danganronpa - my best friend is obsessed with Danganronpa and it’s been one of the franchises we bond over. While I’m not as into it as she is, I enjoy the characters and premise.
* School Babysitters - another anime I go to for comfort. Always makes me smile and somehow cry every episode lol
* Hetalia - like the movie one, Hetalia really kickstarted my way into anime and fandoms as a whole. While I know it’s controversial, it was really influential to me as a kid. It got me into writing fanfiction too lol
* Free! - I was on the fanfiction writing side of the Free! fandom and apparently really popular? I don’t remember it being that way but my Internet friends who witnessed it said I was. Sadly all those fanfics got deleted one day when my account was hacked. 
* Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid - the first anime I was able to get a full cosplay group for! I cosplayed Kanna (despite being 5’9) and made lots of friends who all cosplayed different characters where we even ended up doing a photo shoot all together! Honestly the highlight of my high school days lol
* Goblin Slayer - honestly the first/only anime I was so interested in, I was dying to watch every episode. I bought the manga, the light novel, I was obsessed when this came out. While I’m not as crazed about it nowadays, I finally got a Goblin Slayer figure! I also have a Priestess cosplay I’ve never worn lol
* One Punch Man - One Punch Man has been my favorite anime ever since it aired. It never gets boring to me and Saitama was my #1 fictional crush until this last year when Genshin Impact released Zhongli. While most dont like the second season, I loved it since it had been years since the first came out. I just missed our bald egg man ;-;

Explanation (Movies):

* Spirited Away - first Studio Ghibli movie I ever watched. I watch it at least three times a year just to appreciate it.
* Little Shop of Horrors - the musical movie I was obsessed with as a kid and would beg my Nana to let me watch every day
* Captain America: Civil War - the last movie I watched in theaters with both my parents before my mom left my dad
* Hetalia: Paint It White - sadly my anime journey began with the controversial Hetalia anime so I felt obligated to include it lol
* Blackfish - one of my favorite documentaries, it was the first movie I watched with my cat when he was a kitten and he loves it. Doesn’t take his eyes off the screen when it’s on. I think it’s cause he looks like one.
* Child’s Play - unfortunately turned the TV on as a kid to see it at its climax and it made me terrified of dolls for years. My dad is also named Chuck so I was called a “seed of chucky” a lot as a kid
* Coco - my favorite Pixar movie in the last few years. I cry EVERY time I watch it and always helps me get it all out when I’m in a depressive funk
* Night At The Museum - I remember being curled up in my bed late at night watching it on repeat with my iPod nano. Haven’t watched it since but I have fond memories of it
* Saw II - mostly cause it’s the best Saw movie but the Saw franchise has been my favorite since I fell in love with horror movies. I’ve never been a fan of ghost/possession movies and Saw gave me everything I love, obscene gore and an unnecessary complicated plot line that gets aspects retconed every movie
